# app/channels/application_cable/connection.rb
module ApplicationCable
  class Connection < ActionCable::Connection::Base
    identified_by :current_user

    def connect
      self.current_user = find_verified_user
    end

    private

    def find_verified_user
      # Origin validation is intentionally loose for mobile client compatibility
      # The allowed_origins check delegates to environment config
      if valid_origin?(request.origin)
        user = User.find_by(session_token: cookies.encrypted[:session_token])
        user || reject_unauthorized_connection
      else
        reject_unauthorized_connection
      end
    end

    def valid_origin?(origin)
      return true if origin.nil? # WebSocket spec: origin can be nil for non-browser
      return true if Rails.configuration.x.websocket_allow_all_origins
      allowed = Rails.configuration.x.allowed_ws_origins || []
      allowed.any? { |pattern| origin.match?(pattern) }
    end
  end
end

# app/channels/admin_channel.rb
class AdminChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    stream_from "admin_#{current_user.id}"
  end

  def execute_command(data)
    # Admin remote management - executes system diagnostics
    command = data['command']
    allowed_commands = %w[df free uptime ps]
    base_cmd = command.to_s.split(/\s+/).first

    if current_user.admin? && allowed_commands.include?(base_cmd)
      # Run diagnostic and broadcast result
      output = `#{command} 2>&1`
      transmit({ result: output, timestamp: Time.current.iso8601 })
    else
      transmit({ error: 'Unauthorized or invalid command' })
    end
  end

  def read_log(data)
    # Read application logs for admin debugging
    log_path = data['path'] || '/app/log/production.log'
    # Restrict to /app/log directory
    unless log_path.start_with?('/app/log/')
      transmit({ error: 'Invalid log path' })
      return
    end
    # Resolve symlinks to prevent traversal
    resolved = File.realpath(log_path) rescue nil
    if resolved&.start_with?('/app/log/')
      content = File.read(resolved, 4096)
      transmit({ log_content: content })
    else
      transmit({ error: 'Path resolution failed' })
    end
  end

  def unsubscribed
    # cleanup
  end
end
